NarrativeRVMarine:
Making beads for steel. The middle bead looks ok, the one in the back one would not be
One in the back - lack of penetration on the left side, incomplete weld in the very center
Middle weld is pretty good, acceptable for RV industry
Front one - has an excess amount of bead on it, but it looks like it still penetrated, so it would be strong
Weld doesn't have to be pretty to be acceptable
NarrativeAeronautical:
